@import "./omni-foundations.css";
:root{--bg:#090b12;--surface:#111522;--surface-2:#171c2c;--line:#2a3042;--text:#f4f6ff;--muted:#9299ad;--violet:#8b6cff;--cyan:#32dfd0;--danger:#ff6f91;--radius:22px}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%,#171329 0,transparent 32%),var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,sans-serif}.ambient{position:fixed;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.16;pointer-events:none}.ambient-one{width:380px;height:380px;background:var(--violet);top:-180px;right:5%}.ambient-two{width:320px;height:320px;background:var(--cyan);bottom:-180px;left:10%}.shell{width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 40px));margin:auto;position:relative}.topbar{height:92px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid strong{color:var(--cyan)}.brand-mark{display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--violet),#543ac8);font-weight:800}.connection{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem}.connection span:first-child{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#f0b44c;box-shadow:0 0 12px currentColor}.connection.online span:first-child{background:var(--cyan)}.entry-layout{min-height:calc(100vh - 92px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:8vw;align-items:center;padding:70px 0}.intro h1{font:700 em{display:block;color:var(--violet);font-style:normal}.intro>p{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1.7;max-width:610px}.promise{display:flex;gap:18px;margin-top:30px;align-items:flex-start}.promise>span{font:700 rgba(0,0,0,.35)}.entry-panel{border-radius:var(--radius);padding:36px}.entry-panel h2{font:700 1.55rem "Space Grotesk";margin:0 0 30px}.entry-panel label{display:block;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:#c9cede;margin:18px 0}.entry-panel label span{float:right;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}input{width:100%;margin-top:9px;border:1px solid rgba(139,108,255,.14)}.button{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:13px;padding:15px 18px;font:700 .9rem Inter;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s transform,.2s opacity}.button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}.primary{color:white;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--violet),#6546de);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(97,70,222,.24)}.secondary{margin-top:10px;color:#dfe2ef;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line)}.error{color:var(--danger);min-height:18px;font-size:.82rem}.hidden{display:none!important}.arena{display:grid;grid-template-columns:300px 1fr;gap:28px;padding:40px 0}.side-panel,.question-card{border-radius:var(--radius)}.side-panel{padding:26px;align-self:start}.room-heading{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:5px;padding-bottom:24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.room-heading span{grid-column:1;color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em}.room-heading strong{font:700 1.7rem "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:.12em}.room-heading button{grid-row:1/3;grid-column:2;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border-radius:9px;padding:0 10px;cursor:pointer}.roster-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:25px 0 12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}.player{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 0}.avatar{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;background:#252b3e;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;color:var(--cyan)}.player-name{font-weight:700;font-size:.88rem}.player-state{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.7rem;margin-top:3px}.score{font:700 0}.stage-top{min-height:85px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.stage-top span{color:var(--cyan);font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em}.stage-top h2{font:700 1.7rem "Space Grotesk";margin:7px 0}.timer{width:74px;height:74px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-content:center;text-align:center}.timer strong{font:700 1.65rem "Space Grotesk"}.timer span{font-size:.6rem;color:var(--muted)}.question-card{min-height:420px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,58px)}.question-card>p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:0}.question-card h3{font:700 clamp(1.8rem,4vw,3rem)/1.16 "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.03em;max-width:800px}.answers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:34px}.answer{min-height:66px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;background:#101421;color:var(--text);padding:15px;text-align:left;font:600 .9rem Inter;cursor:pointer}.answer:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--violet);background:#17152a}.word-form{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:34px}.word-form input{margin:0}.word-form .button{width:auto}.reveal{margin-top:26px;border-left:3px solid var(--cyan);padding:12px 18px;color:#dfe4f4;line-height:1.6}.reconnect{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:10px;background:#171c2c;border:1px solid
